text:
Ada Park: heads up 19; need a small asset pack for the WM webinar launch: 1) printable one-pager (US letter, PDF) with a compact benchmark chart + 3-line lead routing diagram, 2) 3-panel social carousel (1200x1200 each) showing latency, cost, and recommended model picks, 3) email header (600x200) for the invite. Brand-safe colors only. Deadline: Wed EOD PST. Please confirm ETA and filenames.
Maria Chen: on it. for the carousel, do you want separate data-dense vs narrative panels or a single themed sequence?
Ada Park: sequence please: panel 1 = headline + sparkline (latency vs cost), panel 2 = top-3 model table with per-1k token costs, panel 3 = CTA + lead routing mini-diagram. Tone: keep visuals tight for socials, provide a data sheet link on the one-pager.
Eli Navarro: will do. sample data for the sparkline: latency_ms = [42, 48, 57, 69, 74] and cost_per_1k = [0.40, 0.32, 0.22, 0.14, 0.09]. Prefer overlay with dual y-axis if legible; fallback to two adjacent sparklines.
Maria Chen: noted. alt text for the chart?
Ada Park: alt text (under 250 chars): "Sparkline comparing model latency (ms) rising from 42 to 74 and per-1k token cost falling from $0.40 to $0.09 across model variants."
brand-bot: Brand checklist 19: primary palette REDWOOD-500 #B91C1C + neutrals; typefaces: Inter (body), GT Aligned (headings); max 2 typefaces; contrast 4.5:1 for text; export retina @2x. See internal brand guidelines: https://brand/redwood-guidelines.
Ada Park: include tiny copyright line: "A9 Redwood Inference 2026" and small note: "Internal benchmark summary B7 do not republish."
Eli Navarro: routing/ops note: registration form must push these hidden fields to SFDC: campaign=wm24_bench, source=webinar, lead_flag=benchkit. Also add a mapping: when score >= 70 -> assign owner_pool=bench_sales. Jordan, confirm if Sales needs any extra tags.
Jordan Li: confirmed. Sales wants an additional tag lead_priority=medium by default; we'll update owner_pool when MQL reached. I'll drop the mapping spreadsheet to Ops after this thread.
Maria Chen: filenames I'll use for handoff: wm24_print_onepager_v1.pdf, wm24_carousel_panel1_1200x1200.png, wm24_carousel_panel2_1200x1200.png, wm24_carousel_panel3_1200x1200.png, wm24_email_header_600x200.jpg. Figma proto will live in /brand/marketing/wm24/carousel.
Ada Park: tiny diagram requirement: 3-step horizontal flow with icons and labels: 1) Register (form) -> 2) Ops qualifies (score) -> 3) Book demo (sales). Keep lines thin, icons mono-line.
Maria Chen: accessibility: I'll include tagged PDF, descriptive alt text, and longer description in the one-pager metadata. Also will prepare a compressed PNG and SVG source for the diagram.
Eli Navarro: ETA: first drafts tomorrow morning, revised comps Tue midday, final exports Wed EOD. Will @Ada when drafts are live.
Ada Park: perfect, thank you! :rocket:
